class: A value fetched once when the page opens and shown beside values that refresh on a timer: it goes stale while the page looks live.
mechanism: The rule check was read once per page open; the live figures refreshed.

first_seen.evidence: The stop warning showed 2.07 % for 5 minutes while the real figure was 7.46 %; the plan card would show a pre-tightening limit after 13:00.

fix: The rule check is re-read on the page's one refresh and shows the server's as-of time; a failed re-read keeps the old lines with a could-not-refresh mark.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check.

occurrences.evidence: The stop warning showed 2.07 % for 5 minutes while the real figure was 7.46 %; the plan card would show a pre-tightening limit after 13:00.
